title: Travelling the tracks in style
paragraphs: Who doesn't love a train? Since the invention of the first steam-powered locomotive in the UK in 1804, this powerful mode of transport has helped keep human progress on track. If they weren't hauling freight in cars, they'd be pulling passengers in carriages. In the modern era, the iron horse is still chugging along under its own steam. And these days, many are attracted to it for its comfort, style and luxury.

In the UK, a new £150m fleet of Caledonian Sleepers has just been unveiled. These overnight trains provide an experience that will 'transform travel between London and Scotland,' says Ryan Flaherty of Serco, the company operating the rail service, in a BBC article. Indeed, the fleet features 40 sleeper carriages fitted with showers, a club car for dining and new engineering in the couplers to prevent shunting from waking resting passengers.

But it doesn't stop there. All over the globe, luxury trains deliver comfort and opulence on rails to passengers looking to let off steam. Why not try a whistle-stop tour of India on The Maharajas' Express? Taking 88 guests at a time on a four or eight-night trip, the train boasts restaurant cars, a bar and a lounge. If South Africa is more to your taste, you can travel for over 31 hours from Cape Town to Pretoria in a spacious cabin boasting five-star service on The Blue Train. Fancy South America? The Belmond Andean Explorer is its first sleeper train. They boast it is one of the highest train routes in the world. It can whisk you across Peru from Cusco, the Incan capital, to Arequipa, 'the White City'. And of course, no mention of locomotive luxury would be complete without the famous Venice Simplon-Orient-Express, the well-known setting of a popular murder mystery novel. Travelling across Europe to various destinations such as London, Paris and Venice, its art deco cabins are manned by stewards and feature a resident pianist.

Trains are old. And it is perhaps this age that appeals to many people. Stepping on board a luxury train to travel as we used to long ago evokes romantic memories of grand journeys at a more measured pace. If this appeals to you, why not consider one for your next holiday? I'm sure your experience will be anything but a train wreck.

vocabulary.entry: steam-powered locomotive /ˌstiːm ˈpaʊəd ˌləʊkəˈməʊtɪv/ 蒸汽机车
vocabulary.example: The first steam-powered locomotive revolutionized transportation in the 19th century.
vocabulary.translation: 第一台蒸汽机车在19世纪彻底改变了交通运输方式。

vocabulary.entry: mode of transport /məʊd ɒv ˈtrænspɔːt/ 交通工具；运输方式
vocabulary.example: Bicycles are an environmentally friendly mode of transport.
vocabulary.translation: 自行车是一种环保的交通工具。

vocabulary.entry: keep...on track /kiːp ɒn træk/ 使……步入正轨；使……稳步发展
vocabulary.example: Regular planning helps keep the project on track.
vocabulary.translation: 定期规划有助于让项目稳步推进。

vocabulary.entry: haul freight /hɔːl freɪt/ 运输货物
vocabulary.example: This truck is used to haul freight across the country.
vocabulary.translation: 这辆卡车用于在全国各地运输货物。

vocabulary.entry: carriage /ˈkærɪdʒ/ n. （火车）车厢
vocabulary.example: She walked through the carriage to find an empty seat.
vocabulary.translation: 她穿过车厢去找空座位。

vocabulary.entry: iron horse /ˈaɪən hɔːs/ 铁马（火车的昵称）
vocabulary.example: The iron horse has been a vital part of transportation for over two centuries.
vocabulary.translation: 两个多世纪以来，火车一直是交通运输的重要组成部分。

vocabulary.entry: chug along /tʃʌɡ əˈlɒŋ/ （车辆、火车等）突突地缓慢行驶
vocabulary.example: The old train chugged along through the countryside.
vocabulary.translation: 这列老旧的火车突突地缓慢行驶在乡间。

vocabulary.entry: under its own steam /ˈʌndə ɪts əʊn stiːm/ 依靠自身动力
vocabulary.example: The small boat sailed across the lake under its own steam.
vocabulary.translation: 这艘小船依靠自身动力驶过了湖面。

vocabulary.entry: fleet /fliːt/ n. 车队；船队；机群
vocabulary.example: The airline has a new fleet of modern aircraft.
vocabulary.translation: 这家航空公司拥有一支由新型客机组成的机队。

vocabulary.entry: unveil /ʌnˈveɪl/ v. 揭幕；首次展示
vocabulary.example: The company will unveil its new smartphone next month.
vocabulary.translation: 这家公司将于下月推出新款智能手机。

vocabulary.entry: overnight train /ˌəʊvəˈnaɪt treɪn/ 夜间列车
vocabulary.example: We took the overnight train from Beijing to Shanghai.
vocabulary.translation: 我们搭乘了从北京到上海的夜间列车。

vocabulary.entry: fitted with /ˈfɪtɪd wɪð/ 配备有；装有
vocabulary.example: The new office building is fitted with solar panels.
vocabulary.translation: 这座新办公楼装有太阳能电池板。

vocabulary.entry: coupler /ˈkʌplə(r)/ n. （火车的）车钩
vocabulary.example: The engineer checked the couplers before the train departed.
vocabulary.translation: 列车出发前，工程师检查了车钩。

vocabulary.entry: shunting /ˈʃʌntɪŋ/ n. （火车的）调车作业
vocabulary.example: Shunting operations at the station usually take place at night.
vocabulary.translation: 车站的调车作业通常在夜间进行。

vocabulary.entry: opulence /ˈɒpjələns/ n. 奢华；富裕
vocabulary.example: The hotel is famous for its opulence and excellent service.
vocabulary.translation: 这家酒店以其奢华的设施和优质的服务而闻名。

vocabulary.entry: let off steam /let ɒf stiːm/ 宣泄情绪；放松身心
vocabulary.example: Going for a run is a good way to let off steam after a stressful day.
vocabulary.translation: 经历了压力大的一天后，跑步是放松身心的好方法。

vocabulary.entry: whistle-stop tour /ˈwɪsl stɒp tʊə/ （政客的）短暂巡回访问；短途观光旅行
vocabulary.example: The president went on a whistle-stop tour of the southern states.
vocabulary.translation: 总统对南部各州进行了一次短暂的巡回访问。

vocabulary.entry: boast /bəʊst/ v. 拥有（值得自豪的东西）
vocabulary.example: The city boasts several world-famous museums.
vocabulary.translation: 这座城市拥有好几家世界著名的博物馆。

vocabulary.entry: spacious cabin /ˈspeɪʃəs ˈkæbɪn/ 宽敞的车厢
vocabulary.example: The spacious cabin made the long journey more comfortable.
vocabulary.translation: 宽敞的车厢让长途旅行变得更舒适。

vocabulary.entry: whisk /wɪsk/ v. 迅速送离；快速移动
vocabulary.example: The taxi whisked us to the airport just in time.
vocabulary.translation: 出租车迅速送我们到机场，刚好赶上时间。

vocabulary.entry: art deco /ˌɑːt ˈdekəʊ/ 装饰艺术风格（流行于20世纪20-30年代）
vocabulary.example: The building has a beautiful art deco facade.
vocabulary.translation: 这座建筑有着漂亮的装饰艺术风格外立面。

vocabulary.entry: train wreck /treɪn rek/ 火车失事；（喻）一团糟的局面
vocabulary.example: The party was a total train wreck because no one brought any food.
vocabulary.translation: 这场派对彻底搞砸了，因为没人带吃的来。

sentences.english: Who doesn't love a train?
sentences.chinese: 谁会不喜欢火车呢？

sentences.english: Since the invention of the first steam-powered locomotive in the UK in 1804, this powerful mode of transport has helped keep human progress on track.
sentences.chinese: 1804年，英国发明了第一台蒸汽机车，自此以后，这种强大的交通工具一直推动着人类的发展稳步前行。

sentences.english: If they weren't hauling freight in cars, they'd be pulling passengers in carriages.
sentences.chinese: 火车不是用货运车厢运输货物，就是用客运车厢搭载旅客。

sentences.english: In the modern era, the iron horse is still chugging along under its own steam.
sentences.chinese: 在现代社会，这匹“钢铁骏马”依旧依靠自身动力稳步驰骋。

sentences.english: And these days, many are attracted to it for its comfort, style and luxury.
sentences.chinese: 如今，许多人被火车的舒适、格调与奢华所吸引。

sentences.english: In the UK, a new £150m fleet of Caledonian Sleepers has just been unveiled.
sentences.chinese: 在英国，价值1.5亿英镑的全新“喀里多尼亚卧铺列车”车队刚刚亮相。

sentences.english: These overnight trains provide an experience that will 'transform travel between London and Scotland,' says Ryan Flaherty of Serco, the company operating the rail service, in a BBC article.
sentences.chinese: 运营这条铁路线路的瑟科公司的瑞安·弗莱厄蒂在接受英国广播公司采访时表示，这些夜间列车带来的体验将“改变伦敦与苏格兰之间的旅行方式”。

sentences.english: Indeed, the fleet features 40 sleeper carriages fitted with showers, a club car for dining and new engineering in the couplers to prevent shunting from waking resting passengers.
sentences.chinese: 事实上，这支列车编队配备了40节卧铺车厢，车厢内设有淋浴间，还有一节供乘客用餐的俱乐部车厢，车钩处也采用了全新的设计工艺，防止调车作业的动静吵醒休息的旅客。

sentences.english: But it doesn't stop there.
sentences.chinese: 但奢华列车的魅力远不止于此。

sentences.english: All over the globe, luxury trains deliver comfort and opulence on rails to passengers looking to let off steam.
sentences.chinese: 在全球范围内，奢华列车都在为想要放松身心的旅客提供舒适奢华的铁路旅行体验。

sentences.english: Why not try a whistle-stop tour of India on The Maharajas' Express?
sentences.chinese: 何不在“王公快车”上开启一场印度短途观光之旅呢？

sentences.english: Taking 88 guests at a time on a four or eight-night trip, the train boasts restaurant cars, a bar and a lounge.
sentences.chinese: 这趟列车每次可搭载88名乘客，行程分为四晚和八晚两种，列车上配有餐车、酒吧和休息厅。

sentences.english: If South Africa is more to your taste, you can travel for over 31 hours from Cape Town to Pretoria in a spacious cabin boasting five-star service on The Blue Train.
sentences.chinese: 如果你更喜欢南非，不妨搭乘“蓝色列车”，在宽敞的车厢里享受五星级服务，从开普敦到比勒陀利亚，全程历时31个多小时。

sentences.english: Fancy South America?
sentences.chinese: 对南美洲感兴趣？

sentences.english: The Belmond Andean Explorer is its first sleeper train.
sentences.chinese: “贝尔蒙德安第斯探索者号”是当地的首趟卧铺列车。

sentences.english: They boast it is one of the highest train routes in the world.
sentences.chinese: 据称，这趟列车的运行线路是全球海拔最高的铁路线路之一。

sentences.english: It can whisk you across Peru from Cusco, the Incan capital, to Arequipa, 'the White City'.
sentences.chinese: 它能载着你穿越秘鲁，从印加古都库斯科一路前往“白城”阿雷基帕。

sentences.english: And of course, no mention of locomotive luxury would be complete without the famous Venice Simplon-Orient-Express, the well-known setting of a popular murder mystery novel.
sentences.chinese: 当然，提到奢华列车，就不得不提著名的“威尼斯-辛普伦东方快车”——一部热门悬疑谋杀小说的故事就发生在这里。

sentences.english: Travelling across Europe to various destinations such as London, Paris and Venice, its art deco cabins are manned by stewards and feature a resident pianist.
sentences.chinese: 这趟列车穿梭于欧洲各地，终点涵盖伦敦、巴黎、威尼斯等多个城市，其装饰艺术风格的车厢配有乘务人员，还常驻着一位钢琴师。

sentences.english: Trains are old.
sentences.chinese: 火车已经存在许久了。

sentences.english: And it is perhaps this age that appeals to many people.
sentences.chinese: 或许正是这份历史感吸引了许多人。

sentences.english: Stepping on board a luxury train to travel as we used to long ago evokes romantic memories of grand journeys at a more measured pace.
sentences.chinese: 登上一列奢华列车，像很久以前那样旅行，能唤起人们对往昔从容惬意的盛大旅行的浪漫回忆。

sentences.english: If this appeals to you, why not consider one for your next holiday?
sentences.chinese: 如果你也被这种旅行方式打动，下次度假时为何不考虑尝试一下呢？

sentences.english: I'm sure your experience will be anything but a train wreck.
sentences.chinese: 我敢肯定，你的体验绝对不会是一场“灾难”。
